description.value:
Biometric locks use unique physical characteristics as access keys. The number of Thievery checks required to bypass a biometric lock can be reduced if the creature attempting the check has access to a sample or recreation of the key; the remaining Thievery checks represent the finesse needed to properly use these fake samples.

Bypass requires four successful @Check[computers|dc:26] or @Check[thievery|dc:30] checks; voice sample reduces the number of required Thievery checks by 2.
